What We Do

Tree services in Lutz and the Tampa Bay area

Every job starts with a free estimate. Tell us the service you need right on the form and we will take it from there, safe, clean, and guaranteed.

Tree Removal

Tree Removal in Lutz, FL

Safe and effective removal of hazardous trees near your home and dead trees anywhere on your property. We bring the tree down carefully, protect your property and family, and haul everything away.

Tree Trimming

Tree Trimming & Pruning

Keep your trees at their healthiest and best looking. We improve the tree structure, remove dead or overgrown branches, and shape the canopy for better health and curb appeal.

Stump Grinding

Stump Grinding in Lutz, FL

Expert stump grinding removes ugly stumps below ground level and gives you a clean, level yard, ready for landscaping, sod, or whatever comes next.

Storm Clean-Up

Hurricane Relief & Storm Damage Clean-Up

When hurricanes hit, we are your first choice for storm damage clean-up. From securing damaged sites to removing fallen trees and clearing debris, our crew is ready, 24/7.

Land Clearing

Land Clearing in Hillsborough County

Remove unwanted trees, bushes, and debris and get your land ready to build. Our specialized equipment clears even the most difficult terrain, thoroughly and safely.

Guaranteed Work

Quality Work, Guaranteed

Over 25 years of tree and land work, our own cutting-edge equipment, and rates that stay affordable. 15% discounts for military, seniors, and first responders on top of a free estimate.

Fence Installation

Improve your property security and curb appeal with a new fence. We work with metal, vinyl, chain link, and wood, help you choose the right design and materials, and finish the installation expertly.

Demolition

Modest demolition for homes that need more than tree work. Whether it is an old fence or a small structure, our crew takes it down securely and efficiently, with the least disturbance possible.

Tree emergency after a storm? We are open 24/7. Call (813) 953-6257 any time.
